'''Brunar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] officer in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where she trained fellow Sith in the skill of [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeology]]. She held the rank of Reclamation [[Captain/Legends|Captain]].
